name: 桌面操作
description: Background Windows computer use with an independent Agent pointer and local MCP tools.
description_zh: 后台操作 Windows 桌面，Agent 指针与用户鼠标解耦，支持跨软件点击和滚动。
description_en: Use an independent Agent pointer for background clicks and scrolling across Windows apps.
examples_zh: 查看桌面并点击指定的软件按钮
跨窗口执行操作，完成后停止并隐藏 Agent 指针
examples_en: Inspect the desktop and click the requested app control
Operate across windows, then stop and hide the agent pointer
